content:
If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 10-15% in late horizon to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 5-10% in mid horizon to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast diverges >5% from recent 7-day average, apply a smoothing filter to reduce volatility in early horizon.  
When sentiment spikes to 1.00+ in 2 consecutive days, shift forecast upward by 2-3% in late horizon to reflect momentum.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is above 70, reduce by 3-5% in mid horizon to align with bearish sentiment.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is below 70, increase by 2-4% in early horizon to capture bullish momentum.
